testnet_final._note: Fresh stack deployed 2026-10-08 (scripts/testnet_deploy_stack.sh) carrying the fixes from a six-agent audit of all three tranches (see docs/TRANCHE3_DELIVERABLES.md): token now validates encrypted_note length on transfer/transfer4/unshield (Medium); governance can now actually call verifier.pause()/unpause() and token.pause()/unpause(), which were previously unreachable (High); swap's reveal_and_claim now binds the output note's randomness at commit time, closing a Critical front-running/value-destruction path. viewing_keys is reused unchanged from the prior stack (no coupling to the others, no live state to lose). Governance is the verifier's and token's admin; swap and compliance admin is the deployer zkella-testnet-deployer; guardian is zkella-testnet-guardian. Governance was built with the testnet-fast-timelock feature, so timelock_ledgers() is 60 (about 5 minutes), NOT the 7-day production timelock. Verifying keys for all six circuits are live via the timelock. Native XLM is approved on the token through governance. Compliance sanctions root is the empty-list root (sentinels only), not a real sanctions list. Deploy transaction hashes are not recorded here; see the deploy log's own transaction links for initialize/queue/execute steps.
